commentary_title: Sustained high utilisation driven by grain trade and regional demand
commentary_summary: Vessel utilisation remained elevated, following a significant increase last week, primarily due to heightened grain trade on the US– Europe route as the US grain harvesting season commenced. | Meanwhile, spot rates on the China–East India route have shown a steady upward trend over the past month, reflecting growing vessel demand | Additionally, there has been a surge in 'laden tonnage at anchor' in the Indian Ocean, indicating rising activity in the region
